info.title: ImageArtifex API
info.description:
Layered image editing over HTTP. Every edit is an op appended to the project history with a plain-English description;
the browser editor, the CLI and API clients all share it, and edits show up live in open editors.

Typical agent loop: GET /api/state (layers, selection, recent history) → POST /api/ops (one op or a batch) →
GET /api/export to look at the result. Set "author" so the history shows who made each change.
Layer and path references accept ids ("L3", "P1") or names. Coordinates are canvas pixels, origin top-left.
The server listens on 127.0.0.1 only; reach it from elsewhere through an SSH tunnel.

get.summary: An uploaded or generated image asset

Curve.description: Curve control points [[in, out], ...] (0–255), monotone cubic through them

LayerProps.description: Layer properties. Common ones are listed; type-specific ones (text: text/font/size/weight/color/align; shape: shape/w/h/fill/stroke/strokeWidth/radius; fill: color; gradient: kind/x1/y1/x2/y2/stops) are accepted too. A tone property set to null removes it.

parent.description: Group id to put the layer in (null = top level)

clip.description: Clipping mask: only show where the nearest unclipped layer below has pixels

distort.description: Distort filter (GIMP Distorts / Lens Distortion); null removes

liquify.description: Set to null to remove all liquify strokes

path.description: Text on a path (set with text.onPath); {offset} moves the text along it; null = normal text

mesh.description: Perspective / warp mesh in layer coordinates (use layer.perspective / layer.warp to set it in canvas px); null removes

alpha.description: Paint only where there are pixels already

colorBalance.description: GIMP color balance; values -100..100 per range

Layer.description: A new layer. image: give "src" (a file path on the server) or "asset" (from POST /api/upload). paint: an empty layer for strokes.

type.description: adjustment: holds tone/filter props (levels, curves, ...) that apply to every layer below it

src.description: image: file path on the server to import

text.description: text: the text (\n for new lines)

boxWidth.description: text: paragraph width px (text wraps inside it)

SelectionShape.description: rect/ellipse {x,y,w,h}; polygon {points}; path {subpaths}; wand {x,y,threshold?,contiguous?,layer?} (fuzzy select); color {x,y | color, threshold?, layer?} (select by color); alpha {layer}; all.

Subpaths.description: Bezier path: anchors with optional absolute handle positions (in/out); a missing handle is a sharp corner.

Entry.description: One history entry: the op as stored (names resolved to ids, files imported) and its plain-English text.

Op_canvas_new.title: canvas.new
Op_canvas_new.description: Start the document (written by "artifex init"; normally not sent by clients)

Op_canvas_resize.title: canvas.resize
Op_canvas_resize.description: Change the canvas size; layers keep their place relative to the anchor

Op_layer_paste.description: Paste layers from another project (or this one), editable, with their masks, adjustments and images
